title: Handy to use
text: Handy to use. I have some larger metal Mugs for traveling and the outside of the mug is kind of smooth and has a tendency to slip out of my hand so I got a set of these grippers to put on the bottom of the mug and they were perfect they sit in the cup holder better in the vehicle and also just to pick them up lot easier to handle my cups.

product_metadata.title: KUFUNG Mug Cup Sleeve Silicone Nonslip Heat-resistant Glass Bottle Coffee Cup Protector Cover Ceramic Double Wall Insulated Travel (2, White)
features: 【Size】: 2 x Cup Sleeves; Fit Cup Upper Dia: 7.6cm/3"; Fit Cup Lower Dia: 6.3cm/2.5". Please check the size chart reference before purchase.
【Material】: Our cup sleeve are made from silicone. Durable and unbreakable. Amazing feel for your hands and a totally cool grip.
【Good insulation】: The glass bottle sleeve can protect the glass body against hot. Flexibility and remarkable resistance to heat or cold.
【MJIYA cup sleeve】 : It can slow down the transfer of heat from beverages to outside. Allows you to easily take hot water and won't burn your fingers.
【Multi-application】: Perfect for glass bottle, plastic cup, mug, insulated mug, cold tumblers, water bottles, mason jar, etc.
